abilityTiers.name: Technique
abilityTiers.guidance: Never for a move taught by Special Move Training (that is a Special Move). A sharper everyday use of the character's own Quirk, training or gear: a new shape, range, rhythm or control of something they already do. Strain light or moderate (Stamina brief or demanding for trained techniques). Most learned moves are Techniques.

abilityTiers.name: Special Move
abilityTiers.guidance: ALWAYS the tier of a move taught by Special Move Training (the first full success of the attempt), named "Special Move: <name>", and of any learned move that states an exact impact. Strain moderate or heavy.

abilityTiers.name: Ultimate Move
abilityTiers.guidance: Only for a character with the Quirk Breakthrough trait: their all-out finisher, at the edge of what their Quirk can do. Strain severe. Never from training alone.
